web.searxng_note: FREE web supplement (the Perplexica substance). searxng=true tries the self-hosted SearXNG (docker compose up -d searxng, :8888) FIRST at $0, then falls back to the paid OpenRouter/Perplexity providers below only if it's down or empty. local_llm_url is OPTIONAL neutral synthesis on a free OpenAI-compatible box (Mac Mini Ollama http://192.168.1.217:11434 or cupcake) — blank means use the raw snippet digest (still free, zero LLM dependency). Set searxng=false to force the paid path.

impartiality.excluded_note: Robert's standing rule: never name/surface these outlets. In a cite-everything architecture there is no mine-silently path (a claim either shows the source name or is uncited), so we simply do not source from them. Matched case-insensitively against a source's url + publisher + title. Add any outlet Robert flags as disrespectful.
